quests.title: Hole Punch
quests.summary: The Silk Museum's curator needs a Jacquard pattern card taken down to the weaver at Paradise Mill.

steps.text: Take the punched pattern card to the weaver at Paradise Mill, down by the river.
Read the blue plaque on the front of Paradise Mill: when did its looms stop?
Tell the curator at the Silk Museum when Paradise Mill's looms stopped.

quests.reward: A Macclesfield Silk Square, a Bakewell Tart and a bit of standing in England.
